    Diamond closure facts: arrows after γ and after ω #

    • X2: an arrow φ out of a with γ ≫ φ nonzero in P/τ is α or begins η (the D̃₄ star Out3 at a).
    • X4: an arrow e out of y with ω ≫ e nonzero in P/τ begins ω' (the D̃₄ star MD4B at y).
